get.description: This API retrieves settlement details that the bank needs to settle. The input can be either the settlement date or a Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) number.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: HMAC SHA512 authorization header built from merchant_key and merchant_secret (required). Format: hmac username="<merchant_key>", algorithm="sha512", headers="date", signature="<hex_sha512_hash>"

parameters.name: Date
parameters.description: Request timestamp used in signature (required). Format: Wed, 28 Jun 2023 11:25:19 GMT

parameters.name: mid
parameters.description: Merchant identifier (required). Example: 135670

parameters.name: settledOn
parameters.description: Settlement date to query in YYYY-MM-DD format (required if UTR not provided). Date must be <= today.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for paginated response (required).

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of records per page (required). Must be between 2000 and 50000.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Result type filter (optional). Accepts 'G' or left blank.

parameters.name: isVersion
parameters.description: API version selector (optional). Valid values 1 or 2.

get.description: This API provides transaction-level data for a specified date or date range and returns paginated results.

parameters.name: Date
parameters.description: Request timestamp in UTC string format (e.g., 'Wed, 28 Jun 2023 11:25:19 GMT') (required)

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: SHA512 HMAC-style header built from request data, Date, merchant key and secret in the form: hmac username="<key>", algorithm="sha512", headers="date", signature="<hexhash>" (required)

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (required). If only start date provided, end date defaults to same date.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional). When omitted, system uses dateFrom. Must be >= dateFrom and date range must not exceed 3 days.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for paginated response (required). 1-based integer.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of records per page (required). Max allowed 50000, practical recommendation: <=500 to avoid timeouts.

get.summary: Merchant Upcoming And Pending Settlement API
get.description: This API retrieves upcoming and pending settlement information for the merchant. No query parameters or request body required.

parameters.name: mid
parameters.description: Merchant identifier the integration was registered with (mandatory). Can be string or integer.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Response content type (recommended). Should be 'application/json'.

get.description: This API retrieves detailed transaction information for settlement reconciliation purposes using your merchant transaction ID.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: Bearer token for authentication (required). Format: 'Bearer <token>'

parameters.name: mid
parameters.description: Your Merchant ID (required). Can be integer or string.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Response content type (recommended). Should be 'application/json'.

parameters.name: merchantTransactionId
parameters.description: Your unique merchant transaction/reference ID used to look up settlement entries (required). Length: 1-100 characters.
